reviews.text:
Contracted Tropic Island Pools to build a pool and outdoor kitchen, which included a 3 year warranty. We have open warranty items that they will not resolve and will not return phone calls, emails, etc. Save yourself the headache and choose another competent builder who will communicate better.

Most recent issue is that the columns crumbling. Made them out of CMU and Without a foundation, said gunnite crew didn’t have time to spray them when pool was formed. Still 2 years left of warranty and not even a call back.
reviews.author: Michael Kardokus

reviews.text: My experience with Tropic Island was absolutely horrible. Communication was non-existent, the carelessness of the work was absolutely ridiculous, They broke my fence in multiple spots with the machinery, they almost starting digging in the wrong spot from having the wrong blueprint, they had to come back multiple times to "fix" my fence while they left it broken for weeks at a time knowing that I have pets. They installed the wrong lights in my pool delaying the process even longer. They left my yard with trash all over it on multiple occasions. The attention to detail was just not there. I get that covid and rain played a factor and I tried to be accommodating, but when I have to constantly reach out to managers and owners of the company to get an update after weeks of not hearing from someone or being lied to it is unacceptable. Nick was and is the only person who seemed to actually care about what happened and tried to make amends and that's why I would give them 1 star not 0.
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.text: Okay!! I recently moved to McKinney from Chicago and was so thrilled about a possibility of owning a pool. I had enquired at several places and they were all willing to talk only if we were ready to spend a minimum of $75,000 and it’s without addons features etc. and wherever I saw pool work it took a minimum 5 months to complete. Brian Waltz at Tropic island was the person we interacted with and we felt extremely comfortable pursuing our project with him. We finished our whole and huge pool with upgrades and travertine pavers in $75k and in 2 months. Great communication, updates and keeping up timelines. I would highly recommend working with Tropic Island pools and Brian Waltz. Thank you Team for your awesome work!
reviews.author: Tarani Lakshman

reviews.text:
I am pleased to write a review for Tropic Island Pools.  My husband and I recently bought a home in the Plano area.  Our home has a beautiful pool.  Our initial contact with Tropic Island pools was to set up maintenance service.  We chose them because they had a good reputation and because they are a family owned business.  We have been incredibly pleased with our maintenance service.  In fact, it was our maintenance technician that noticed that we had an issue with our pool system (which we had already suspected) that needed attention.  He immediately texted us and recommend that we turn off the power to avoid any damage to our system.   At our request, Tropic Island Pool had a technician at our home within 48 hours.  The technician contacted me by text letting me know when he would be arriving, quickly diagnosed the problem, and immediately sent me a work estimate via email to review and approve.  I reviewed the cost, which I found reasonable, and approved the work. I texted the technician again and asked if he could repair it right then and there.  He said yes.  I also asked him to check out a few other issues which he did and is reviewing.  I was back at our new house yesterday.  The pool looks fantastic, crystal clear, and the system is humming along.

Greatly appreciate the expertise, response time, and the ability to communicate via text and email as we are still in the process of moving.  Everyone with whom I have interacted at Tropic Island Pools has not only been professional and knowledgeable, but also very pleasant!

Highly Recommend Tropic Island Pool
reviews.author: Dr. B Hanson

reviews.text: We’ve had these guys cleaning our pool for a while now.  Service used to be decent, but has declined rapidly.  We tried to get someone to call us to talk about a needed repair, but could never get anyone to actually call us back.  Left multiple messages with their answering service, but nothing.  Left a message saying that we wanted to cancel our service, nothing.  Said to stop charging our credit card, nothing. Still charged it.  Unbelievable really.  Not sure how a company like this stays in business.
reviews.author: James Mangus

reviews.text: Contacted Tropic Island to trouble shoot a potential problem with our Sand Filter.  They were booked solid and not able to provide service for more than a week - but they showed up on the day promised and the Technician (Kevin) was professional, thorough and quickly confirmed the issue was not with the filter and was able to improve the skimmer return flow by adjusting the valves.  And Tropic Island waived the service fees because they could not provide more timely service.  I strongly recommend Tropic Island for pool service.
reviews.author: Steven Sapp

reviews.text: Called and left a vm for this company 3 days ago. Broken pump. No call back. No nothing. This company doesn’t know how to do the basics - answer the phone, call power back, etc. Delete them from your contacts and find the pool guys who know how basic business 101 works. The phone rings, you answer it, or call them back the next day. Not complicated.
reviews.author: Russell Riggins

reviews.text: Very helpful and responsive folks at Tropic Island Pools. I used them for weekly maintenance for my home and several repairs up until it sold. They kept me informed and did quality work at a very affordable price. I'd would definitely recommend and use them again in the future.
reviews.author: Russell Tarpley

data.summary: Reviews show mixed authenticity. High ratings on some platforms with low review counts contrast with detailed, credible complaints on Google and a concerning BBB F rating. The negative reviews contain specific, recurring issues (warranty, communication, property damage) that appear genuine.
fake_signals: Limited review volume on high-rating platforms (Yelp/Angi/Houzz have 5-7 reviews each)
Potential review solicitation on niche platforms
BBB F rating with no complaint details provided
authentic_signals: Specific negative details in Google reviews (names, broken fence, wrong lights, warranty issues)
Varied writing styles in both positive and negative reviews
Positive reviews mention specific staff (Brian Waltz, Kevin)
complaint_patterns: Charging for services after cancellation request
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between high ratings on Yelp/Angi/Houzz (4.9-5.0) and low Google rating (4.0) with serious complaints. BBB F rating indicates unresolved business issues.
